note: Rewritten from the original description by Mjöberg (1920), the original in English (published under the genus Hamitermes). The text was taken from the OCR of the Internet Archive scan, in which the specific name was misread as lativeiitris; the measurements have been corrected against the context (e.g. 2,o7 recorded as 2.07, 1,6 5 recorded as 1.65).

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Very similar to the alate of A. obtusidens, but the frontal gland is wider and more rounded at the sides and the reddish yellow ring around the eyes is narrower; the mandibular dentition is very similar; the antennae are also similar, 15-segmented, but segment 3 sometimes tends to divide into two very short segments, and segments 13 and 14 are distinctly longer than in A. obtusidens (twice as long as wide); the wing shape and colour are also similar, but the bent vein that runs into the membrane and then turns abruptly towards the wing apex is absent; the radial sector forks from the middle of the wing and gives off 2—3 veins; the cubitus has about 10 unbranched oblique veins. Measurements: body length with wings 12 mm; body length without wings 7 mm; head length 1.05 mm; head width 1.16 mm; pronotum length 0.53 mm, width 0.95 mm; forewing length 10.3 mm, width 2.5 mm; hindwing length 10 mm, width 3 mm; abdominal width 1.5 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Pale yellow, the head pale reddish yellow. Head much larger than in A. obtusidens, higher and more convex at the sides, steeply inclined downwards in front, widest at the middle, the posterior margin and sides rounded; clypeus very small and narrow, its sides and anterior margin white, the middle of the anterior margin slightly concave; labrum not wide, tapering abruptly towards the rounded apex; mandibles very stout, their apex less strongly curved than in A. obeuntis, with the same deep notch forming a freely projecting median tooth (but not so sharp as in that species); antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 completely free (in A. obeuntis it is fused with segment 4), segments 6—14 distinctly longer than wide, segment 15 narrow, more than twice as long as wide; anterior margin of the pronotum carinate, the sides rounded and hairy; legs long and hairy; abdomen very wide and rounded, cerci long. Measurements: body length including mandibles 5 mm; head length including mandibles 2.07 mm; head length without mandibles 1.65 mm; head width 1.29 mm; pronotum length 0.42 mm, width 0.74 mm; abdominal width 1.5 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Slender, white to pale yellow, the head pale reddish yellow. Head rounded, flattened at the top; basal part of the clypeus more than twice as long as wide, the sides rounded, the apex white and projecting in the middle; labrum wide with a rounded apex; mandibles stout, the dentition very similar to that of A. obtusidens; antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 undivided or divided into two very short segments, segments 14 and 15 twice as long as wide; pronotum carinate and rounded; abdomen slender and rounded. Measurements: body length 5 mm; head length 1.37 mm; head width 1.18 mm; pronotum length 0.49 mm, width 0.71 mm; abdominal width 1.6 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Closely related to A. obtusidens; the alates of the two are similar at first sight, but the shape of the frontal gland and the apical antennal segments differ, and so do the wing veins; the soldier is very similar to A. obeuntis, but the shape of the mandibles and labrum and the number of antennal segments differ. It builds very simple earthen galleries under stones; many alates, 1 soldier and many workers were collected in November (month 11) at Christmas Creek, southern Queensland.
